blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Lossless image compression fundamentally relies on accurate entropy modeling, driving a recent shift toward large language model (LLM)-based methods. However, existing approaches mainly emphasize the modeling capacity of LLMs while directly serializing images into pixel or residual sequences, leaving heterogeneous signal patterns entangled within a single prediction stream. In this paper, we argue that effective entropy modeling depends not only on model capacity, but also on the predictability of the input representation. Motivated by this insight, we propose WaveLLM, a wavelet-domain LLM-based entropy model for lossless image compression. By decomposing an image into multi-level wavelet subbands, WaveLLM converts a heterogeneous prediction problem into a set of more structured and statistically homogeneous subproblems that are more amenable to autoregressive probability estimation. To bridge numerical coding symbols with the LLM's native text token space, we introduce a dedicated numerical interface featuring value embeddings and a coefficient prediction head. Furthermore, a task-adaptive prompting strategy is designed to enable a single shared model to adapt to diverse subbands within a unified framework. Built on Llama-3.2-3B with LoRA adaptation, WaveLLM achieves 2.51, 2.24, and 2.27 bpsp on Kodak, CLIC.pro, and DIV2K, respectively, outperforming the PixelCNN-based codec using the same wavelet transform by 0.43, 0.36, and 0.46 bpsp, and surpassing recent LLM-based lossless compressors on all three benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 无损失图像压缩从根本上依赖于精确的 en模型,推动最近转向了以大语言模型(LLM)为基础的方法. 然而,现有方法主要强调LLMS的建模能力,同时将图像直接序列化为像素或剩余序列,使不同的信号模式被缠绕在一个单一的预测流中. 在本文中,我们主张,有效的py模型不仅取决于模型容量,而且取决于输入表示的可预测性. 基于这种洞察力,我们提出"WaveLLM",一种以"波"为主的以"波"域为主的以"LLM"为主的无损图像压缩的 en模型. 通过将一幅图像分解成多级波段子带,WaveLLM将一个多相异的预测问题转换为一组结构更合理,统计上更一致的子问题,更适合自回概率估计. 为了将数字编码符号与LLM的原生文字符号空间相接,我们引入了以数值嵌入和系数预测头为特色的专用数字界面. 此外,还设计出一项适应任务的激励战略,使单一共享模式能够在统一框架内适应不同的分带。 在Llama-3.2-3B上由LORA改型而来,WaveLLM在Kodak, CLIC.pro和DIV2K上分别实现2.51, 2.24和2.27 bpsp,使用同波变换的PixelCNN编码器在0.43,0.36和0.46 bpsp上表现优于最近基于LLM的无损失压缩器,在所有三个基准上都超过了.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en:
Unlike lossy compression, which can trade distortion for bitrate, lossless image compression fundamentally relies on entropy coding. Classical codecs improve this process through carefully designed predictors, reversible transforms, and context models ( Boutell, 1997 ; ITU-T and ISO/IEC JTC 1, 1998 ; Weinberger et al., 2000 ; Sneyers and Wuille, 2016 ; Taubman and Marcellin, 2002 ; Alakuijala et al., 2019 ) , while learned methods have further advanced coding efficiency by using neural networks to capture more complex dependencies ( Mentzer et al., 2019 ; Hoogeboom et al., 2019 ; Townsend et al., 2020 ; Bai et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2021b ; Zhang et al., 2021a ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .
Related work spans image and video coding, feature and representation compression, and other structured signals, with associated datasets, benchmarks, and quality assessments ( Huang et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Sheng et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2025a ; Gao et al., 2025b ; Sheng et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2025c ; Gao et al., 2025d ) . These directions provide broader context for our setting, while recent lossless image coding explores large language models (LLMs) as entropy models ( Deletang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
与损失压缩可以交易扭曲比特率不同的是,无损失图像压缩从根本上依赖于Entropy编码. 古典编码器通过精心设计的预测器,可逆变换和上下文模型改进了这一过程(Boutell,1997年;ITU-T和ISO/IEC JTC 1,1998年;Weinberger等人,2000年;Sneyers和Wuille,2016年;Taubman和Marcellin,2002年;Alakuijala等人,2019年),而学习的方法通过利用神经网络捕捉更复杂的依赖性进一步提高了编码效率(Mentzer等人,2019年;Hoogeboom等人,2019年;Townsend等人,2020年;Bai等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2021b;张等人,2021a;张等人,2024年;李等人,2025年)。
相关工作涵盖图像和视频编码、特征和表示压缩以及其他结构化信号,并附有相关的数据集、基准和质量评估(黄等人,2021年;李等人,2024年;沈等人,2024年;黄等人,2026年;高等人,2025年a;高等人,2025年b;沈等人,2026年;李等人,2026年;高等人,2025年c;高等人,2025年d). 这些方向为我们设定提供了更广泛的背景,而最近的无损图像编码则探索了作为 en模型的大型语言模型(Deletang等人,2024年;Chen等人,2025年;Du等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: In this paper, we argue that the accuracy of probability modeling is determined not only by the modeling capacity of the entropy model itself, but also by the predictability of its input. In other words, better entropy coding should not be attributed solely to a stronger model. It also requires an input representation that is more structured, more homogeneous, and thus easier to predict. When heterogeneous signal patterns are entangled within a single sequence, the entropy model must continuously adapt to sharply different statistical regimes, which makes accurate probability estimation intrinsically more difficult. By contrast, when the input is reorganized into simpler components with clearer statistical regularity, the same model can solve a substantially easier prediction problem.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们主张概率建模的准确性不仅取决于 en模型本身的建模能力,也取决于其输入的可预测性. 换句话说,更好的 en编码不应仅仅归因于更强大的模型. 它还需要一种结构更加合理、更加一致从而更容易预测的投入表述。 当不同的信号模式缠绕在一个单一序列中时, en模型必须不断适应急剧不同的统计制度,这使得准确概率估计在本质上更加困难. 相比之下,当投入重组为更简单且统计规律性更清晰的组件时,同样的模型可以解决一个更简单的预测问题.

blocks.en: Based on this insight, we propose to perform probability prediction and entropy coding in the wavelet domain. As the work most closely related to ours, we compare three LLM-based methods in Fig. 1 . The pixel-domain method directly models pixels ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , requiring the entropy model to handle pixel distributions from different frequency components. The residual-domain method models residuals instead ( Du et al., 2025 ) , which reduces the difficulty of probability modeling to some extent. In our method, we first transform the image into the wavelet domain and decompose it into progressively organized frequency subbands ( Mallat, 1989 ; Daubechies and Sweldens, 1998 ; Taubman and Marcellin, 2002 ) . This decomposition separates coarse low-frequency structures from directional high-frequency details across multiple resolutions ( Mallat, 1989 ; Taubman and Marcellin, 2002 ) , thereby converting a highly heterogeneous prediction problem into a collection of more structured and statistically homogeneous subproblems.
blocks.zh: 基于这种洞察力,我们提议在波浪域中进行概率预测和 en编码. 作为与我们最密切相关的工作,我们在图1中比较了三种基于LLM的方法。 像素域法直接模型像素(Chen et al., 2025),要求肽模型处理不同频率组件的像素分布. 余域法模型残基代之(Du等人,2025年),在一定程度上降低了概率模型的难度. 在我们的方法中,我们首先将图像转换成波浪域,并将其分解为逐渐有组织的频率子波段(Mallat,1989年;Daubechies and Sweldens,1998年;Taubman and Marcellin,2002年)。 这种分解将粗细的低频结构与多个分辨率的定向高频细节区分开来(Mallat,1989年;Taubman和Marcellin,2002年),从而将一个高度多样化的预测问题转化为一个结构更加有序和统计上更加一致的子问题的集合.

blocks.en: Nevertheless, combining the wavelet domain with an LLM is far from natural. Pretrained LLMs are designed for discrete text tokens, whereas wavelet coefficients are numerical symbols from visual signals. To bridge this gap, we design a dedicated interface that makes wavelet-domain entropy coding compatible with the LLM backbone. Specifically, we introduce a coding-oriented numerical adaptation mechanism that maps wavelet coefficients into a compact local symbol space, equips them with trainable value embeddings, and predicts valid coefficient values through a dedicated value prediction head. This design preserves numerical validity while enabling the pretrained LLM to operate effectively on wavelet-domain symbols.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,将波浪域与LLM结合远非自然. Pretrained LLMs是为离散文本符号设计的,而波率系数则是来自视觉信号的数字符号. 为了弥补这个缺口,我们设计了一个专用接口,使波浪域的entropy编码与LLM主干线兼容. 具体来说,我们引入了面向编码的数字适应机制,将波率系数映射到紧凑的局部符号空间,为它们配备可训练值嵌入,并通过一个专用值预测头来预测有效的系数值. 这种设计保留了数字有效性,同时使预先训练的LLM能够在波浪域符号上有效运行.

blocks.en: Another challenge arises from the fact that different wavelet subbands still exhibit distinct statistical characteristics ( Wainwright and Simoncelli, 1999 ; Taubman and Marcellin, 2002 ) . Training an independent entropy model for each subband would significantly increase model complexity and undermine the practicality of LLM-based coding. To address this issue, we further propose a prompt-based adaptive entropy coding strategy, where one shared entropy model is reused across different subbands through task prompts. By conditioning the shared backbone on subband identity and decoded context, the same model adapts its probability predictions to different subband distributions without requiring separate models. In this way, the proposed framework achieves both subband-specific modeling flexibility and parameter efficiency.
blocks.zh: 另一项挑战是,不同的波幅子带仍然显示出不同的统计特征(Wainwright和Simoncelli,1999年;Taubman和Marcellin,2002年)。 为每个子波段培训独立的 en模型将大大增加模型的复杂性,并破坏基于LLM的编码的实用性. 为了解决这一问题,我们进一步提出一个快速适应的 en编码战略,即通过任务提示在不同的子带之间重新使用一个共享py模型。 通过在子波段身份和解码上下文上调共享主干线,同一模型将其概率预测适应不同的子波段分布而不需要单独的模型. 这样,拟议的框架既实现了分带专用模型化的灵活性,也实现了参数效率.

blocks.en: Building on the above designs, we present WaveLLM, a wavelet-domain LLM-based entropy model for lossless image compression. The contributions of this work are threefold. • We note the importance of input predictability in lossless image compression and decompose each image into multiple wavelet subbands. The resulting subbands have distinct coefficient statistics that can be modeled separately. • We design a dedicated interface between wavelet-domain signals and an LLM pretrained on language data. It maps coefficients to compact local IDs, uses a dedicated value embedding module, and predicts valid coefficient values over the local range through a dedicated value head. • We propose a task-prompt mechanism for adaptive modeling of different subbands. By conditioning the shared backbone on subband identity and decoded context, WaveLLM adapts to distinct subband statistics without requiring separate models. As shown in Fig. 1 , WaveLLM achieves 2.51, 2.24, and 2.27 bpsp on Kodak, CLIC.pro, and DIV2K, respectively. Despite using only a 3B backbone, it outperforms recent 8B LLM-based compressors on all three benchmarks while remaining competitive with strong learned lossless codecs.
blocks.zh: 基于上述设计,我们提出了WaveLLM,一个波浪域LLM基于无损失图像压缩的Entropy模型. 这项工作的贡献有三。 我们注意到输入可预测性在无损图像压缩中的重要性,并将每个图像分解成多个波段子带. 由此产生的子带有不同的系数统计,可以单独建模。 我们设计了波幅域信号与语言数据预选LLM之间的专用接口. 它将系数映射到紧凑的本地ID,使用专用值嵌入模块,并通过专用值头来预测本地范围内的有效系数值. ^ 我们提出一个任务即期机制,用于不同子带的适应模型。 通过在子波段身份和解码上下文上调共享主干线,WaveLLM在不需要单独模型的情况下适应不同的子波段统计. 如图1所示,WaveLLM分别在Kodak,CLIC.pro和DIV2K上实现2.51,2.24和2.27 bpsp. 尽管它只使用3B主干线,但是它在所有三个基准上都超过了最近的8B LLM的压缩机,同时保持了与强健的学习型无损失解码器的竞争.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1. Lossless Image Compression
blocks.zh: 2.1. 无损图像压缩

blocks.en:
Classical lossless codecs rely on predictive filtering and entropy coding.
PNG ( Boutell, 1997 ) , JPEG-LS ( ITU-T and ISO/IEC JTC 1, 1998 ; Weinberger et al., 2000 ) , FLIF ( Sneyers and Wuille, 2016 ) , JPEG2000 ( Taubman and Marcellin, 2002 ) , and JPEG XL ( Alakuijala et al., 2019 ) represent widely used designs. The reversible 5/3 lifting transform in JPEG2000 provides a practical route to lossless wavelet coding ( Taubman and Marcellin, 2002 ; Daubechies and Sweldens, 1998 ) .
Learned compression methods have explored causal autoregressive models such as PixelCNN and PixelCNN++ ( van den Oord et al., 2016 ; Salimans et al., 2017 ) , hierarchical latent-variable models ( Mentzer et al., 2019 ; Hoogeboom et al., 2019 ; Townsend et al., 2020 ) , invertible flows ( Zhang et al., 2021b ; Zhang et al., 2021a ) , residual coding ( Mentzer et al., 2020 ; Bai et al., 2024 ) , and bit-plane decompositions ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) .
Across these approaches, the central challenge remains accurate probability estimation over high-dimensional discrete image signals. CALLIC ( Li et al., 2025 ) reports strong learned-method results through content-adaptive per-image optimization.
blocks.zh:
经典的无损解码器依赖于预测过滤和 en编码.
PNG(Boutell,1997年),JPEG-LS(ITU-T和ISO/IEC JTC 1,1998年;Weinberger等人,2000年),FLIF(Sneyers and Wuille,2016年),JPEG2000(Taubman and Marcellin,2002年),以及JPEG XL(Alakuijala等人,2019年)代表了广泛使用的设计. JPEG2000的可逆5/3起重变速器为无损失的波浪编码提供了一条实用路线(Taubman and Marcellin, 2002; Daubechies and Sweldens, 1998.).
学习的压缩方法探索了PixelCNN和PixelCNN++(van den)等因果自递性模型. Oord等人,2016年;Salimans等人,2017年),分级潜在可变模型(Mentzer等人,2019年;Hoogeboom等人,2019年;Townsend等人,2020年),不可逆流(Zhang等人,2021b;Zhang等人,2021a),残余编码(Mentzer等人,2020年;Bai等人,2024年),以及比特飞机分解. (张等,2024).
通过这些方法,中心挑战仍然是对高维离散图像信号的准确概率估计。 CALLIC(Li等人,2025年)报告,通过内容适应的每个图像优化,得出了强大的学习方法结果.

blocks.en: 2.2. Wavelet-Domain Codecs
blocks.zh: 2.2. 波浪域编码器

blocks.en:
Wavelets decompose an image into low-frequency structure and high-frequency detail at multiple resolutions ( Mallat, 1989 ; Daubechies and Sweldens, 1998 ) .
Natural-image wavelet coefficients are non-Gaussian and subband dependent ( Wainwright and Simoncelli, 1999 ; Taubman and Marcellin, 2002 ) , with broader low-frequency responses and sparse, sharply peaked high-frequency coefficients.
This separation makes the wavelet domain attractive for entropy modeling. WaveFormer and BVINet incorporate wavelet modules into Transformer-based video inpainting ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ) . Unlike these restoration models, WaveLLM uses a reversible wavelet decomposition and decoded same-level subbands for lossless entropy coding.
In lossless coding, JPEG2000 established the canonical framework by combining the reversible 5/3 integer lifting transform with wavelet-domain context modeling and arithmetic coding ( Taubman and Marcellin, 2002 ) .
The lossless branches of iWave and iWave++ use reversible 5/3 wavelet coding with learned PixelCNN entropy models ( Ma et al., 2020 ; Ma et al., 2022 ) .
WaveLLM studies this setting and replaces the PixelCNN-style entropy model with a shared prompted LLM over codec-defined subband tasks.
blocks.zh:
Wablets在多个分辨率下将一个图像分解成低频结构和高频细节(Mallat,1989年;Daubechies and Sweldens,1998年)。
自然图像波率系数是非古西语和亚波段的依赖性(Wainwright和Simoncelli,1999年;Taubman和Marcellin,2002年),低频响应范围更广,高频系数很少,急剧达到顶峰。
这种分离使得波浪域对 en建模具有吸引力. WaveFormer和BVINet将波浪模块纳入基于变形器的视频插图(Wu等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年)。 与这些修复模型不同,WaveLLM使用可逆波分解并解码的同级子波段用于无损失的 en编码.
在无损失编码中,JPEG2000通过将可逆的5/3整数提升变换与波浪域上下文模型和算术编码(Taubman and Marcellin, 2002)相结合,建立了舟子框架.
iWave和iWave++的无损失分支使用可逆的5/3波列编码,与已学习的PixelCNN en型(Ma等人,2020年;Ma等人,2022年).
WaveLLM研究了这个设置,并用一个共享激发的LLM取代了PixelCNN风格的Entropy模型,而不是代码定义的子波段任务.

blocks.en: 2.3. LLMs for Lossless Image Compression
blocks.zh: 2.3. 无损失图像压缩LLMS

blocks.en:
Beyond compressing intermediate representations produced by large models ( Gao et al., 2025c ; Gao et al., 2025a ; Gao et al., 2025d ; Gao et al., 2025b ) , recent LLM-based image compression directly employs pretrained language models as entropy models ( Deletang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2025 ) .
Delétang et al. demonstrated that autoregressive language modeling can be interpreted directly as compression ( Deletang et al., 2024 ) .
In image coding, two recent methods apply pretrained LLMs to lossless compression.
P 2 -LLM keeps the problem in the pixel domain and frames compression as next-pixel prediction ( Chen et al., 2025 ) .
The visual-prompt method introduces a lossy reconstruction as an auxiliary cue and codes the residual with an LLM ( Du et al., 2025 ) .
Both papers report Llama-3-8B backbones.
WaveLLM takes a different route.
It introduces LLM-based entropy modeling into a reversible 5/3 wavelet codec, using a 3B backbone adapted through LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) .
Unlike P 2 -LLM, which processes a rasterized pixel stream without codec-defined structure, and the visual-prompt method, which requires an auxiliary lossy codec to generate visual embeddings, WaveLLM operates within the causal structure of the wavelet codec.
It relies on decoded context that is already available at each coding stage.
At the coefficient interface, it also differs from the reserved-vocabulary strategy used by P 2 -LLM by introducing a dedicated local value-ID space together with separate value embedding and prediction modules.
blocks.zh:
除了压缩大型模型产生的中间表示(Gao等人,2025c;Gao等人,2025a;Gao等人,2025d;Gao等人,2025b)之外,最近基于LLM的图像压缩直接使用经过预先训练的语言模型作为py模型(Deletang等人,2024;Chen等人,2025;Du等人,2025年)。
Delétang等人证明,自递性语言建模可以直接解释为压缩(Deletang等人,2024年).
在图像编码中,最近两种方法应用了预先训练的LLMs来进行无损压缩.
页:1 2-LLM将问题保留在像素域和帧压缩中,作为下一个像素预测(Chen等人,2025年).
视觉即时法引入了损失重建作为辅助提示,并将剩余部分编码为LLM(Du等人,2025年)。
两份论文都报告了Llama-3-8B骨干.
WaveLLM采用不同的路线.
它使用通过LORA(Hu等人,2022年)改编的3B主干线,将基于LLM的Entropy模型引入了可逆的5/3波段编码器.
与P2-LLM处理一个没有编码自定义结构的光栅化像素流不同,视觉-即时方法需要辅助丢失的编码器来生成视觉嵌入,WaveLLM在波纹编码器的因果结构内运行.
它依赖于在每个编码阶段已经存在的解码上下文.
在系数界面上,它也与P2-LLM使用的预留-vobulary策略不同,采用了专用的局部值ID空间,并配有单独的数值嵌入和预测模块.

blocks.en: 3. Method
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1. Overall Framework
blocks.zh: 3.1. 总体框架

blocks.en:
WaveLLM uses a reversible color transform, a fixed 5/3 wavelet transform, a causal coding order, and arithmetic coding, while the learnable part focuses on wavelet-domain probability factorization over codec-defined subbands.
Figure 2 summarizes this workflow and highlights the entropy-modeling core composed of task prompts, the coding-oriented numerical interface, and the LLM probability model.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en:
Concretely, an 8-bit RGB image is first converted to YCoCg and decomposed by a four-level fixed 5/3 integer wavelet transform.
This produces 13 subbands: the deepest low-frequency band L ​ L 4 LL_{4} and three directional high-frequency bands ( H ​ L l HL_{l} , L ​ H l LH_{l} , H ​ H l HH_{l} ) at each of four levels.
The reversible 5/3 lifting transform maps integers to integers for lossless coding. Table 5 fixes the transform, coding order, and arithmetic coder while varying only the entropy model.
These subbands are coded in a fixed causal order. L ​ L 4 LL_{4} is coded first, followed by the three high-frequency bands at each level from the deepest level to the shallowest.
For each subband, WaveLLM forms a task prompt, maps the resulting value sequence through the coding-oriented numerical interface, and uses the LLM to produce a probability distribution over coefficient values for arithmetic coding.
The decoder entropy-decodes these subbands in the same order as the encoder. After each level is decoded, the inverse wavelet transform synthesizes the next shallower low-frequency band, ultimately reconstructing the original image exactly.

This decomposition restructures the entropy-modeling problem in a way favorable to autoregressive modeling.
High-frequency subbands are dominated by near-zero coefficients with sharply peaked distributions, while the low-frequency L ​ L 4 LL_{4} band carries the bulk of image energy with broader, more structured statistics.
Separating these two regimes into distinct prediction tasks with explicit causal context removes the need for a single model to simultaneously track coarse structure and fine detail.
This challenge is inherent in flat pixel streams.
Section 4.3.1 provides direct experimental evidence for this advantage.

blocks.en:
As illustrated in the right panel of Figure 2 , the LLM input for each subband is organized as a task prompt with two components.
Rather than reusing one generic instruction across all coding steps, WaveLLM assigns each subband a task-specific prompt.
The text prompt is a task-specific natural-language string that identifies the subband type, describes the available context, and states the prediction objective (e.g., “Context: Low-frequency structure. Target: Vertical high-frequency details. Predict: \n ”).
These tokens are produced by the native Llama tokenizer and processed through the frozen text embedding module.
The text prompt serves not only as a label but as the primary mechanism through which the shared backbone activates different statistical priors for different subbands.
Ablation results in Section 4.4 show that removing prompts causes the largest single-component degradation.
The value sequence contains the serialized integer values of the decoded context and target bands, arranged in causal order and processed through the dedicated value embedding module described in Section 3.4 .
In the representative H ​ L l HL_{l} example shown in Figure 2 , same-level L ​ L l LL_{l} serves as context and H ​ L l HL_{l} is the target band.
Tasks with multiple context bands follow the same template with additional serialized context segments separated by delimiter tokens.
For L ​ L 4 LL_{4} , only the text prompt and target MED residuals are needed.

blocks.en: 3.4.1. Coding-Oriented Numerical Interface
blocks.zh: 3.4.1. 编码导向数字接口

blocks.en:
Integer wavelet coefficients should not be represented as ordinary text tokens for two reasons.
First, although the native Llama vocabulary is indexed by consecutive token IDs, those IDs do not encode numerical locality.
Neighboring token IDs correspond to neighboring text symbols rather than neighboring coefficient values.
Second, raw coefficient values include negative integers and therefore cannot be used directly as valid embedding indices or classification labels.
To bridge this gap, each integer symbol v v is mapped to a local value ID (3) z = v + o , z=v+o, where z z denotes the mapped local value ID, and o = 512 o=512 is a fixed offset that shifts the observed coefficient range into the valid local range { 0 , … , K − 1 } \{0,\ldots,K-1\} with K = 2048 K=2048 while preserving numerical ordering.
Near-zero coefficients, which are the most common values in high-frequency subbands, therefore fall near the center of this local space.
Statistics show that valid coefficients satisfy v ∈ [ − 512 , 1535 ] v\in[-512,1535] .

邻接的代号ID对应邻接的文本符号而不是邻接的系数值.
第二,原始系数值包括负整数,因此不能直接用作有效的嵌入指数或分类标签.
为了弥补这一差距,每个整数符号v被映射到一个本地值 ID (3),z = + o,z = v+o,其中z 表示映射的本地值 ID,而o = 512 o = 512是一个固定的抵消,将观测到的系数范围转换为有效的本地值范围{0,...,K − 1 }} {0,\ldots,K-1\} 与 K = 2048 K = 2048,同时保留数字顺序.
近零系数是高频子波段中最常见的值,因此落在这个局部空间的中心附近.
统计数据表明,有效系数满足了v {} [− 512, 1535] v\ in [-512, 1535].

blocks.en:
Text prompt tokens and the delimiter token sep pass through the frozen text embedding module E text E_{\text{text}} (Figure 4 , lower path).
Coefficient and residual values pass through a trainable value embedding module E val ∈ ℝ K × d E_{\text{val}}\in\mathbb{R}^{K\times d} (upper path), where d d is the LLM hidden dimension.
This separation ensures that text semantics and coefficient numerics are processed through independent embedding pathways, avoiding the vocabulary mismatch that arises when coefficient values are treated as ordinary text tokens.
It also differs from the reserved-vocabulary design in P 2 -LLM. WaveLLM defines a dedicated local value space with its own value embedding and value prediction head.
The two embedding streams are then merged in a task-specific sequence assembly step: (4) X = { [ E text ​ ( p L ​ L ) , E val ​ ( z ⁡ ( r L ​ L ) ) ] , L ​ L 4 task , [ E text ​ ( p b ) , E val ​ ( z ⁡ ( C l b ) ) , E text ​ ( sep ) , E val ​ ( z ⁡ ( y l b ) ) ] , HF task , X=\begin{cases}[E_{\text{text}}(p_{LL}),\,E_{\text{val}}(z(r_{LL}))],&\text{$LL_{4}$ task},\\[3.0pt]

When C l b C_{l}^{b} contains multiple context bands, the same delimiter token is inserted between successive context segments in the same causal order.
On the output side, a trainable value prediction head W val ∈ ℝ K × d W_{\text{val}}\in\mathbb{R}^{K\times d} (i.e., 2048 × d 2048\times d ) replaces the full-vocabulary LM head for target positions.
For more stable training, both E val E_{\text{val}} and W val W_{\text{val}} are initialized from a consecutive block of pretrained Llama parameters.
This keeps the scale of the pretrained parameters, while the actual prediction space remains the local value vocabulary rather than the native full text vocabulary.

blocks.en: 4.1. Experimental Settings

blocks.en: 4.1.1. Datasets

Training uses three natural-image datasets: the NIC training set (607,715 images at 256 × 256 256\times 256 ), the DIV2K training split (800 images at approximately 2K resolution) ( Agustsson and Timofte, 2017 ) , and the Flickr2K training split (2,650 images) ( Lim et al., 2017 ) .
We use a two-stage schedule.
The model is first pretrained on the lower-resolution NIC corpus and then finetuned on the higher-resolution DIV2K and Flickr2K images.
All training images are disjoint from the held-out evaluation sets.
Model selection uses a separate validation split.
blocks.zh:
训练使用三个自然影像数据集:NIC训练集(607,715幅图像,256×256\times 256),DIV2K训练分裂(800幅图像,约2K分辨率)(Agustsson和Timofte,2017),Flickr2K训练分裂(2,650幅图像)(Lim等人,2017).
我们用两个阶段的时间表。
该模型首先在下分辨率的NIC实体上进行预训,然后在高分辨率的DIV2K和Flickr2K图像上进行微调.
所有培训图像都与被搁置的评价集脱节。
模型选择使用单独的验证分拆.

blocks.en:
Evaluation is performed on three standard benchmarks: Kodak ( Eastman Kodak, 1993 ) (24 images, 768 × 512 768\times 512 ), the professional track of CLIC ( Toderici et al., 2020 ) (41 images), and the DIV2K validation set ( Agustsson and Timofte, 2017 ) (100 images).
Images are converted to YCoCg and padded to multiples of 16 for four-level wavelet decomposition.
The rates reported for WaveLLM are measured from the written bitstreams and normalized by the original image dimensions before padding.
blocks.zh:
评价按三个标准基准进行: 柯达克(Eastman Kodak,1993年) (24影像,768×512 768\times 512),CLIC的专业赛道(Toderici等人,2020年) (41影像),DIV2K验证集(Agustsson and Timofte, 2017) (100影像).
图像转换为YCoCg,加成倍数16,用于四级波浪分解.
为WaveLLM报告的速率由书面比特流测量,在粘贴前由原始图像维度正常化.

Detailed implementation settings are summarized in Table 1 .
The backbone is Llama-3.2-3B with frozen pretrained weights, and LoRA is applied to the q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj, gate_proj, up_proj, and down_proj modules. The rank, alpha, and dropout are 128, 256, and 0.05, respectively.
The local value range uses K = 2048 K=2048 with offset o = 512 o=512 .
The patch size in Table 1 refers to crops taken from wavelet-domain subbands after full-image transformation.
Training uses batch size 1 with gradient accumulation 16, AdamW, and a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} on 8 RTX 3090 GPUs in bf16.

blocks.en: 4.1.3. Baseline Codecs

blocks.en:
The baselines cover three groups.
Traditional codecs include PNG, JPEG2000, JPEG-LS, FLIF, and JPEG XL ( Boutell, 1997 ; Taubman and Marcellin, 2002 ; ITU-T and ISO/IEC JTC 1, 1998 ; Weinberger et al., 2000 ; Sneyers and Wuille, 2016 ; Alakuijala et al., 2019 ) .
Learned lossless codecs include L3C, RC, iWave, iVPF, DLPR, ArIB-BPS, and CALLIC ( Mentzer et al., 2019 ; Mentzer et al., 2020 ; Ma et al., 2020 ; Zhang et al., 2021b ; Bai et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2025 ) .
LLM-based baselines include Delétang et al., P 2 -LLM, and the visual-prompt method ( Deletang et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Du et al., 2025 ) .

blocks.zh: 4.2. 主要成果

blocks.en: 4.2.1. Comparison with Existing Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2.1. 与现有方法的比较

blocks.en:
Table 2 presents a comparison between WaveLLM and traditional, learned, and LLM-based methods.
Table 2 reports WaveLLM rates alongside rates quoted from prior work. Table 3 combines our iWave and WaveLLM measurements with runtime figures quoted from prior work; Tables 4 and 5 report measurements from our setup.

blocks.en:
WaveLLM with a 3B backbone yields lower rates than both P 2 -LLM and the visual-prompt method, even though both employ 8B backbones.
On Kodak, WaveLLM achieves 2.51 bpsp versus 2.83 bpsp for both LLM competitors, a reduction of 11.3%.
On CLIC.pro and DIV2K, it reaches 2.24 and 2.27 bpsp versus 2.35/2.25 and 2.51/2.29 bpsp, respectively.
WaveLLM is also competitive with CALLIC ( Li et al., 2025 ) , a strong learned method that uses content-adaptive per-image fine-tuning.
Among strong non-LLM baselines, WaveLLM also improves over JPEG XL, the strongest traditional codec in Table 2 , and the lossless iWave codec in the matched 5/3 setting, by 0.36 and 0.43 bpsp on Kodak.
Exact reconstruction was verified on all reported test sets, with no observed value-range overflow or out-of-range input or label indices.

具有3B主干线的WaveLLM率低于P2-LLM和视觉即时方法,尽管两者都采用了8B主干线.

在CLIC.pro和DIV2K上,它分别达到2.24和2.27 bpsp比2.35/2.25和2.51/2.29 bpsp.
WaveLLM也与CALLIC(Li等人,2025年)有竞争力,这是一种很强的学识方法,使用内容适应的每个图像微调.
在强力的非LLM基线中,WaveLLM还比JPEG XL改进,这是表2中最强的传统编码器,在对应的5/3设置中无损的iWave编码器在Kodak上增加了0.36和0.43 bpsp.
所有报告测试组都核实了确切的重建情况,没有观察到数值范围溢出或外部输入或标签指数。

blocks.en: 4.2.2. Computational Cost
blocks.zh: 4.2.2. 计算费用

blocks.en:
Table 3 reports runtime and computational cost on Kodak.
Because hardware, implementation details, and model sizes differ across papers, we interpret these numbers qualitatively.
WaveLLM requires about 2.6 × 10 7 2.6\times 10^{7} kMACs/pixel and takes 65.1 s to encode and 152.8 s to decode each Kodak image in our implementation.
Although its 3B backbone is smaller than the 8B backbones used by prior LLM-based methods, end-to-end runtime remains hardware- and implementation-dependent.
WaveLLM parallelizes its 13 subband tasks across 8 RTX 3090 GPUs, and its peak memory of about 16.2 GB per card allows the full pipeline to fit on 24 GB consumer GPUs.
This implementation also benefits from patch-wise parallel processing and an optimized arithmetic coder.
By contrast, the iWave baseline follows serial pixel-wise inference and is measured on a single RTX 3090 in our environment.
The complexity and timing figures for Delétang et al. are quoted from ( Du et al., 2025 ) rather than measured by us, as the original model weights are not publicly available.
These measurements describe the current implementation; runtime reduction remains future work.

blocks.en: 4.3. Analysis of the Proposed Design
blocks.zh: 4.3. 对拟议设计的分析

blocks.en: 4.3.1. Why the Wavelet Domain
blocks.zh: 4.3.1. 运输 为什么波浪域

blocks.en:
To test directly whether the coding domain matters for LLM-based entropy modeling, we implement two alternative variants under the same general paradigm: a pixel-domain variant that performs next-token prediction on rasterized RGB values, and a residual-based variant that encodes the residual between the original image and a lossy reconstruction, using the global lossy image and the corresponding local reconstruction patch as visual prompts.
Table 4 summarizes results across all three benchmarks. Under the same Llama-3.2-3B backbone and next-token entropy-modeling framework, the wavelet-domain formulation is consistently the strongest.
This comparison is especially relevant because WaveLLM is, to the best of our knowledge, the first LLM-based lossless compressor formulated directly in the wavelet domain.
blocks.zh:
为了直接测试编码域对于基于LLM的Entropy模型是否重要,我们在同一通用范式下执行两个替代变体:一个像素域变体,对光栅化的RGB值进行下个托肯预测,另一个是将原始图像和失落重建之间的剩余部分编码的基于剩余变体,使用全球丢失的图像和相应的局部重建补丁作为视觉提示.
表4汇总了所有三项基准的成果。 在同一Llama-3.2-3B主干线和下接的 en型模型框架下,波浪域配方始终是最强的.
这种比较特别相关,因为据我们所知,WaveLLM是第一种基于LLM的无损失压缩机,直接在Walet域中开发.

blocks.en:
The pixel-domain variant is already competitive, indicating that the value interface and autoregressive LLM framework remain effective beyond the wavelet setting.
However, the wavelet-domain formulation outperforms it by 0.21, 0.11, and 0.17 bpsp on Kodak, CLIC.pro, and DIV2K, respectively.
The residual-based variant yields higher rates under our implementation, and its total rate includes both the lossy base bits and the coded residual bits.
We do not introduce an explicit parametric density model in the residual domain, which may limit how fully the model capacity is used in that setting.
Overall, the wavelet-domain formulation performs best among the tested variants.
blocks.zh:
像素域变体已经具有竞争力,表明值界面和自旋LLM框架在波浪设定之外仍然有效.
然而,波域配方在Kodak,CLIC.pro和DIV2K上分别比它表现好0.21,0.11和0.17 bpsp.
以残基为基础的变体在我们实施时产生较高的速率,其总速率包括损失基位和编码的残基位.
我们没有在剩余领域引入一个明确的参数密度模型,这可能会限制模型能力在这种背景下的充分利用。
总体而言,波幅域配方在测试变体中表现最好。

blocks.zh: 4.3.2. 波浪-域后骨结构分析

blocks.en:
Table 5 shows coding performance for entropy models within the same 5/3 wavelet codec.
The first row uses PixelCNN to autoregressively model the coefficients, while the other rows use LLM backbones of different sizes.
Compared with PixelCNN, WaveLLM-3B reduces the rate from 2.94 to 2.51 bpsp on Kodak ( − - 0.43, − - 14.6%), from 2.60 to 2.24 bpsp on CLIC.pro ( − - 0.36, − - 13.8%), and from 2.73 to 2.27 bpsp on DIV2K ( − - 0.46, − - 16.8%).
WaveLLM-1B already outperforms the PixelCNN baseline, showing that the wavelet-domain formulation remains effective at a smaller backbone scale.
Scaling from 1B to 3B yields further gains of 0.37/0.17/0.23 bpsp, indicating that model capacity still matters within this formulation.
The larger backbone provides more capacity for the shared adapters to specialize across all 13 subband types.
Figure 5 shows each subband’s local gain and contribution to the Kodak01 bitrate.
At every subband, the LLM yields a positive local gain over iWave, which indicates more accurate probability prediction throughout the hierarchy.
Low-frequency and coarse high-frequency bands benefit most, whereas shallow Level-1 bands dominate the total rate because they contain most coded symbols.

blocks.en:
Removing text prompts causes the largest single-component degradation (row b, + + 0.11/ + + 0.21 bpsp on Kodak/CLIC.pro).
Without task-specific instructions, the shared backbone lacks an explicit task-identity signal and tends to approximate an average distribution across the 13 subband tasks.

blocks.en: 4.4.2. Numerical Interface
blocks.zh: 4.4.2. 数字接口

blocks.en:
Using the native Llama vocabulary in place of the value interface increases the rate by + + 0.07/ + + 0.08 bpsp (row c).
Neighboring coefficients may map to distant token IDs, and language-trained embeddings introduce a domain gap. The native 128K vocabulary also defines a less compact probability space.
The proposed local value interface avoids these issues and yields more stable coefficient modeling.

blocks.en: 4.4.3. Context Design

blocks.en:

Using only L ​ L l LL_{l} causes a small loss because it provides most of the useful low-frequency context.
Adding parent-level HF bands is more harmful, likely because the longer sequence weakens local attention and the coarser scale is less aligned with the target statistics.
These results support the current design based on same-level decoded context.

5. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结论

blocks.en: We presented WaveLLM, a wavelet-domain LLM entropy modeling framework for lossless image compression. It combines a coding-oriented numerical interface, task prompts, and same-level decoded context within a LoRA-adapted Llama-3.2-3B backbone. WaveLLM achieves 2.51, 2.24, and 2.27 bpsp on Kodak, CLIC.pro, and DIV2K, respectively, outperforming existing LLM-based compressors on all three benchmarks while remaining competitive with strong lossless codecs. These results suggest that wavelet subbands provide a more suitable representation for LLM-based probability modeling than the tested flat pixel and residual sequences. By separating image content into wavelet subbands and guiding each prediction with task prompts and decoded context, WaveLLM enables more accurate entropy estimation. Future work will consider distillation, quantization, and near-lossless coding.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了WaveLLM,一个波浪域LLM的无损图像压缩的模型框架. 它结合了面向编码的数值界面,任务提示,以及LORA适应的Llama-3.2-3B主干线内的同级解码上下文. WaveLLM在Kodak,CLIC.pro和DIV2K上分别实现2.51,2.24和2.27 bpsp,在三个基准上均优于现有的LLM制式压缩机,同时与强大的无亏损解码器保持竞争力. 这些结果表明,波浪子波段为基于LLM的概率模型提供了比测试的平像素和剩余序列更合适的表示. 通过将图像内容分离成波浪子波段,并用任务提示和解码上下文来指导每个预测,WaveLLM可以实现更准确的 en估计. 今后的工作将考虑蒸馏、量化和几乎无损失的编码。
